prompt_policy: Card names and the unseen archetype name are external metadata only and never enter model prompts. Prompts match the training-caption schema and canonical metadata openings. hclar52 occurs exactly once in art_style. Bounding boxes use stored [y_min,x_min,y_max,x_max] order.
negative_prompt: card frame, card border, title, lettering, readable text, logo, watermark, signature, interface, cropped anatomy, duplicate limbs

prompt.high_level_description: A Fiend-type MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: a small green goblin office clerk runs toward the viewer beneath a collapsing stack of parchment.

style_description.lighting: warm window light with green magical ink highlights
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished digital fantasy rendering with crisp shapes and expressive motion

compositional_deconstruction.background: A softly defocused administrative hall with wooden desks and brass scroll tubes. Blank parchment curves in an S-shaped trail above the central figure while several quills and ink drops streak outward.

elements.desc: A small bright-green goblin with enormous amber eyes, round crooked spectacles, an oversized burgundy waistcoat, loose navy necktie and brass stamp at the belt runs directly toward the viewer. One shoe and one hand are enlarged by foreshortening, creating a lively central silhouette.

prompt.high_level_description: A Warrior-type MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: an armored knight strikes a treasure-chest monster with a glowing rectangular shield.

style_description.lighting: white-gold shield light colliding with crimson light from the chest
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, detailed digital fantasy rendering with crisp armor and dynamic magical effects

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark claims chamber with blurred marble counters and shelves. A circular gold seal and a restrained burst of coins frame the central impact.

elements.desc: A tall knight in ivory plate armor with burgundy cloth lunges diagonally upward. A broad silver sword with a brass tag extends behind the body, while a large rectangular shield resembling a blank stamped document thrusts toward the center in strong perspective.

A mahogany treasure chest surges from the opposite diagonal with its lid open as a tooth-filled jaw. Brass corners, glaring red eyes and smoky crimson energy give it a demonic appearance as the shield overlaps its face at the point of impact.

prompt.high_level_description: A Reptile-type MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: a small bespectacled basilisk guards three coins while petrifying an empty-handed adventurer.

style_description.lighting: soft amber illumination crossed by a narrow emerald glow
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished creature rendering with tactile scales and clean expressive forms

compositional_deconstruction.background: A softly shadowed treasury counter with a brass cash box, tiny coin scale and bundled blank parchment. An emerald beam crosses the image toward the right edge.

elements.desc: A cat-sized green basilisk dominates the frame in three-quarter view. It has glossy scales, bright emerald eyes, half-moon spectacles and a burgundy bow tie. One claw rests sternly on a brass cash box while its curling tail encloses exactly three gold coins.

Only an adventurer's frightened face, empty hand and forearm enter from the right edge. Gray stone spreads across the exposed fingers as a small piece of blank parchment slips downward, leaving the basilisk as the unmistakable primary subject.

prompt.high_level_description: A Dragon-type MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: a five-headed hydra in formal office clothing conducts several contradictory presentations at once.

style_description.lighting: cool cyan projection light beneath warm brass illumination
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, elaborate digital fantasy rendering with expressive dragon anatomy and luminous geometric effects

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark executive chamber with the curved edge of a conference table and a large brass clock centered behind the creature. Five small cyan and violet diagrams form a restrained ring of light.

elements.desc: A broad teal hydra torso in a tailored burgundy waistcoat anchors the center. Five long necks curve outward like wheel spokes, forming a radial silhouette. Each head wears a different necktie and displays a distinct expression: enthusiastic, furious, confused, sleepy or smug.

prompt.high_level_description: A Fiend-type MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: a wooden filing cabinet transforms into a monster and lunges toward a startled clerk.

style_description.lighting: warm desk light contrasted with violet light inside the monster's mouth
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished fantasy creature rendering with tactile wood, brass details and exaggerated perspective

compositional_deconstruction.background: A narrow archive aisle converges behind the subjects in deep shadow. Three blank folders, one bent quill and a loose necktie fly outward from the central attack.

elements.desc: An ornate mahogany filing cabinet fills most of the square and tilts toward the viewer. Two upper drawers form glaring eyes, and the large lower drawer opens into a foreshortened mouth lined with folder-tab teeth and illuminated by violet light.

A young clerk enters partly from the left edge and recoils from the cabinet. The figure wears a burgundy office coat and holds one blank folder between both hands while a ribbon-like wooden tongue curls around the folder.

prompt.high_level_description: A Dragon-type MONSTER card artwork showing the following scene: a colossal elderly dragon raises a glowing brass stamp beneath a celestial abacus halo.

style_description.lighting: burgundy and gold window light surrounding a brilliant white halo
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, premium digital fantasy rendering with imposing anatomy, ornate materials and atmospheric depth

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark cathedral-like office recedes into blue haze. Two stained-glass windows and descending shelves frame the creature symmetrically, while tiny figures at the bottom emphasize its immense scale.

elements.desc: An immense elderly dragon has navy scales, an armored face, half-moon spectacles and burgundy robes across broad shoulders. Wings formed from overlapping blank ledger pages extend beyond both edges. One claw raises a glowing brass stamp toward the viewer beneath a circular abacus halo.

cards.card_name: Ledgendaries Head Office—Department of Quest Expenses

prompt.high_level_description: A Field SPELL card artwork showing the following scene: a monumental fantasy government headquarters processes adventurers through a luminous central rotunda.

style_description.lighting: golden daylight with blue-green magical illumination
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, detailed digital fantasy environment rendering with clear architectural depth

compositional_deconstruction.background: A palatial administrative interior uses strong one-point perspective toward the center. Paired gothic archive towers, orderly balconies and brass scroll tubes frame the main rotunda symmetrically.

elements.desc: A luminous circular rotunda dominates the square like a fantasy basilica. It has a glass dome, spiral balconies and a monumental balanced scale surrounded by orbiting coins, quills and sealed blank parchment, producing one unmistakable architectural silhouette.

A single orderly queue curves from the foreground toward the rotunda. The widely spaced silhouettes include an armored knight, a wizard carrying a smoking wand, a small dragon holding a brass token and a healer carrying blank parchment.

prompt.high_level_description: A Continuous SPELL card artwork showing the following scene: adventurers and their ghostly duplicates perform opposite actions across a glowing divide in a mirrored dungeon.

style_description.lighting: warm orange light on the left mirrored by cool cyan light on the right
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished digital fantasy rendering with precise bilateral composition and crisp magical effects

compositional_deconstruction.background: One stone dungeon chamber is divided exactly in half by a narrow golden vertical beam. A chest, short stair and single swinging axe repeat as clean mirrored shapes on both sides.

elements.desc: On the warm left half, three tightly grouped adventurers open a treasure chest. Several coins rise from the chest while one axe swings downward behind them, creating a compact triangular action scene that stops at the central dividing beam.

On the cool right half, three translucent duplicate adventurers reverse the same poses. Coins spiral into a closing chest while the matching axe rises upward, producing a clear visual inverse of the warm scene.

cards.card_name: This Meeting Could Have Been a Sending

prompt.high_level_description: A Quick-Play SPELL card artwork showing the following scene: an exhausted wizard discovers that a tiny magical message already resolved an ongoing council debate.

style_description.lighting: warm torchlight contrasted with cheerful cyan magical light
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, expressive digital fantasy rendering with clear character acting and delicate magical effects

compositional_deconstruction.background: A softly defocused council chamber contains a curved table, warm torches and five blurred arguing silhouettes. Their raised hands form a loose circular frame behind the main figure.

elements.desc: A weary wizard in layered blue robes fills most of the foreground and slumps toward the viewer. One hand covers the face while the other raises a small crystal near one disbelieving eye, creating an immediately readable expression of exhausted realization.

A tiny cheerful cyan spirit emerges from the crystal. Its rounded luminous body and short wing-like arms surround one simple checkmark-shaped flare, making the completed magical message clear without any letters or readable text.

prompt.high_level_description: A Equip SPELL card artwork showing the following scene: a radiant legendary sword is secured to an ordinary equipment counter by a heavy brass chain.

style_description.lighting: intense gold-white radiance against soft green desk light
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished fantasy artifact rendering with meticulous metalwork and luminous energy

compositional_deconstruction.background: A softly blurred equipment counter and dark pegboard form a neutral backdrop. Armored hands holding blank parchment enter from the left, while small green hands holding a pocket watch enter from the right.

elements.desc: A magnificent silver greatsword occupies nearly the entire vertical frame at a slight diagonal. It has a crystal pommel, wing-shaped guard and radiant blade. A thick brass security chain coils around the lower blade and attaches firmly to the mundane counter.

cards.card_name: Your Quest Has Been Selected for Audit

prompt.high_level_description: A Normal TRAP card artwork showing the following scene: adventurers enter a treasure vault and discover a stern inspection team already waiting inside.

style_description.lighting: warm treasure light overwhelmed by white inspection light and red sealing magic
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, dramatic digital fantasy rendering with forceful perspective and crisp magical effects

compositional_deconstruction.background: A compact stone treasury contains one central mound of coins beneath two arches. A large red circular seal frames the figures at the center while four glowing red ribbons lock nearby chests.

elements.desc: The backs and shocked profiles of three adventurers fill the immediate foreground. A treasure sack slips from one hand toward the viewer, and the figures lean apart to reveal the inspection team positioned directly between them.

A compact triangular inspection team waits behind a portable mahogany desk: a small green goblin with crooked spectacles, an ivory-armored knight with a rectangular shield and a tiny green basilisk with half-moon spectacles. All three stare toward the adventurers.

prompt.high_level_description: A Counter TRAP card artwork showing the following scene: a colossal official stamp crushes a dragon-summoning portal as an incomplete ritual reaches its climax.

style_description.lighting: crimson ritual light colliding with white-gold and blue energy
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, explosive digital fantasy rendering with a strong focal collision and luminous energy effects

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark mountaintop platform and two broken pillars frame one crimson portal. Blue lightning and crimson fire compress into a single bright impact ring at the center.

elements.desc: A sorcerer occupies the lower diagonal with both arms raised and dark robes whipping backward. A tiny incomplete piece of blank parchment escapes from one sleeve and remains visible against the portal's crimson light.

A colossal foreshortened brass-and-ivory stamp descends from the upper right and strikes the portal. Its broad base faces the viewer while the head of a horned dragon remains half emerged and visibly compressed beneath it.

prompt.high_level_description: A Quick-Play SPELL card artwork showing the following scene: a panicked goblin presses an emergency button and launches an excessively armored golden rescue machine.

style_description.lighting: emerald activation light against a crimson sky and golden reflections
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, dynamic digital fantasy rendering with exaggerated perspective and brilliant mechanical effects

compositional_deconstruction.background: A simplified government building tilts beneath a crimson sky containing three meteors and one dimensional crack. An emerald beam and restrained arc of coins reinforce the main diagonal.

elements.desc: A small bright-green goblin with enormous amber eyes, round crooked spectacles, an oversized burgundy waistcoat and loose navy necktie fills the lower-left foreground. Both hands strike a large emerald button as the face and flying spectacles show heroic panic.

A golden rescue machine erupts diagonally into the upper-right sky. Dragon-like wings, fortress armor, layered shields and one unnecessary jeweled crown combine into a bold coherent silhouette connected to the button by a brilliant emerald beam.

prompt.high_level_description: A Continuous TRAP card artwork showing the following scene: inspectors measure a gigantic semicircular bite missing from a castle while an orange dragon waits nearby.

style_description.lighting: clear afternoon sunlight with cool blue measuring light
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, detailed digital fantasy environment rendering with clean shapes and playful character acting

compositional_deconstruction.background: A clean blue sky and distant green hills isolate the damaged structure. Three tiny inspectors hang from glowing blue measuring lines around the missing stone while one loose tooth rests near the lower edge.

elements.desc: A single pale stone castle tower fills the left and center. One enormous clean semicircular bite removes nearly half the structure and exposes two tiny rooms, creating a powerful negative shape that remains recognizable at small display size.

A large orange dragon sits tightly cropped at the right edge with folded arms, puffed cheeks and an impatient glare. It delicately holds a tiny brass queue token between two claws while looking toward the inspectors.

prompt.high_level_description: A Normal SPELL card artwork showing the following scene: magical relics and red ribbons spiral into a tiny filing drawer while a fractured sky repairs itself.

style_description.lighting: radiant rainbow-white light against dark red and blue surroundings
style_description.art_style: hclar52 card illustration, polished digital fantasy rendering with strong radial motion and brilliant magical effects

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark records hall forms radial lines around a bright crack in reality. One sword, one crown, one dragon tooth, several coins, a broken wand and crimson ribbons follow a clockwise spiral toward the center.

elements.desc: A tiny open mahogany filing drawer floats at the central vanishing point in dramatic perspective. A small bright-green goblin wearing crooked spectacles and a burgundy waistcoat braces both feet against its edge while pushing one final glowing golden seal inside.
